transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because the things that usually make me feel like myself have started feeling flat and heavy. Photography walks, mentoring the kids, even keeping my calendar organized—I just haven’t been initiating any of it.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and three months now. It started after a family member’s health and behavior changed, and I ended up taking on more of the coordination.
Before this started about fifteen months ago, had you ever experienced another time in your life when you felt this way?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another period that felt quite like this before then.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt unusually high, energized, or wired?

Yeah, I have stretches where I feel unusually upbeat, like everything is clicking and I’m very sure of myself. But then something small—like somebody moving a meeting—can set me off, and I get sharp with people in a way that surprises me.
When you have those stretches of feeling unusually upbeat and energized, how long do they typically last?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really kept track of how long those stretches last.
During those times when you feel especially upbeat and energized, do you find you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?
Yes. There have been nights where I only sleep two or three hours, wake up before dawn, and feel ready to start answering emails or updating appointment lists instead of being tired.
During those times when you felt unusually energized or upbeat, did it ever cause serious problems in your work or personal life, or lead to hospitalization?

I haven’t been hospitalized, and my work has stayed intact overall. But I’ve missed calendar details and had to double-check tasks that used to be automatic. I’ve also pulled back from photography outings and mentoring because I don’t feel as present or reliable.
During these past fifteen months, have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, depressed, or empty most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I can’t say I’ve noticed a stretch like that lasting two weeks straight.
Do those energized or upbeat periods typically last for at least four days in a row?

Yeah, I think so. For most of this whole time, I keep cycling back into those driven, overly confident stretches where I’m sleeping less and taking on too much. Some weeks are quieter, but those periods do tend to go on for several days at a time.
During these past fifteen months, was there ever a period of at least two weeks in a row where you lost interest or pleasure in almost all of your usual activities?
Yeah. The things that usually make me feel like myself—photography walks, mentoring the kids, even keeping my calendar straight—started feeling flat and heavy. I just stopped initiating them.
During those two-week periods when you lost interest in your activities, did you also experience a persistent lack of energy or feel unusually fatigued nearly every day?
I wouldn’t say it was mainly tiredness. It was more that everything felt flat and heavy, and I just couldn’t get myself to start the things I usually do.
During those two-week periods when you lost interest in your activities, did you have trouble sleeping or find yourself sleeping much more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I noticed the loss of interest more than any clear change in my sleep.
During those two-week periods, did you notice any significant changes in your appetite or your weight?
I’m not sure, honestly. I didn’t notice any clear change in my appetite or weight during that time.
During those two-week periods when you lost interest in things, did you struggle with strong feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt?
I’m not sure. I didn’t really notice strong guilt or feeling worthless during those times.
During those two-week periods when you lost interest in things, did you have trouble concentrating or making decisions?
I’m not sure. I didn’t notice any major trouble concentrating or making decisions during those periods.
During those times when things felt flat and heavy, did you have any thoughts of death, dying, or hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t recall having thoughts like that during those times.
